Question Choices: An automated server backup runs every 9 hours. If the first backup runs at 02:00, at what hour on a 24-hour clock will the 6th backup occur? Answer in the form HH:00.
Solution: The 6th backup is 5 intervals after the first: 2 + 5 × 9 = 47, and 47 ≡ 23 (mod 24). So it runs at 23:00.

Question Choices: Six friends sit in a circle numbered 1 to 6 in clockwise order. A ball is passed clockwise, skipping 2 people each time (to every 3rd person). If Person 1 starts with the ball, who receives the 7th pass?
Solution: Each pass adds 3 mod 6. After 7 passes the position is 1 + 7 × 3 = 22, and 22 ≡ 4 (mod 6). Person 4 receives the 7th pass.

Question Choices: If a leap year occurs every 4 years and 2024 was a leap year, what is the remainder when 2098 is divided by 4?
Solution: 2098 = 4 × 524 + 2, so the remainder is 2 (2098 is not a leap year).

Question Choices: A doctor works a repeating schedule: 4 days on shift followed by 2 days off (a 6-day cycle). If Day 1 of her cycle falls on a Sunday, what day of the week will her 10th day off fall on?
Solution: She is off on days 5 and 6 of each cycle, so her 10th day off is day 6 of the 5th cycle: Day 30 overall. Day 30 is 29 days after Day 1, and 29 ≡ 1 (mod 7), so it is one day after Sunday: Monday.

Question Choices: What is the units digit of 7^23? (Hint: look for the repeating pattern of units digits.)
Solution: Units digits of powers of 7 cycle 7, 9, 3, 1 (length 4). 23 mod 4 = 3, so the units digit is the 3rd in the cycle: 3.

Question Choices: What is the units digit of 3^2026?
Solution: Units digits of powers of 3 cycle 3, 9, 7, 1 (length 4). 2026 mod 4 = 2, so the units digit is the 2nd in the cycle: 9.
